pts = [

]
# linear fit F = a + b*(-z) or F vs z slope = -k
n=len(pts)

- Base block 140 x 140 mm, with a yellow guard ring around the specimen seat. The seat cup sits on an elastomer

n=len(pts)
sx=sum(x for x,f in pts)

sxf=sum(x*f for x,f in pts)
den=n*sxx-sx*sx

    print(x,f, round(pred,3), round(f-pred,3))
